title: Birth-time rectification
houses: not a house matter. The instruments are the Ruling Planets at judgment, the lagna's sign/star/sub/sub-sub lords, the Moon, and the event CSLs used to verify   [BHT-NC1-0053, BOS-BTR-1008, BOS-BTR-1012, YB20-0038]

A birth RP that does not match must have its star-lord and sub-lord among the judgment RPs. Drop RPs in the star or sub of retrograde planets. Rectification cannot be absolute. The RPs of the moment the astrologer feels the urge to rectify select the astrologically correct time; different moments can give different times. Always verify against life events.  [BOS-BTR-0001, KP-BEG-071]

Fix the Moon's star by RP first, then the rising sign whose lord is an RP, then its star by the strongest RP, then the sub by the RP appearing most often, then the sub-sub by the balance node. Preference order: Asc star, Asc sign, Moon star, Moon sign, day lord. The degree where all four lords operate jointly is the birth Ascendant. A birth before sunrise belongs to the previous weekday.  [AS10-0059, KSU-PRG-0047, HAR-RP-0048, BHT-PRA-0024]
**Year unknown.** Jupiter is slow, so its sub fixes the year; the Sun's sub fixes the month; the Moon's sub fixes the date. The weekday must be an RP.  [BOS-BTR-1036, KSU-PRG-0051]
Timing: the ladder for this event (resol: T5 ruling planets: RPs of the moment of rectification, with the Moon and lagna lords to the sub-sub level.  [YB20-0038, BOS-BTR-0001, KP-BEG-071]
